FROM THE PUBLISHER

The publisher’s proposed AI lab.

Musa Ozdem publishes this guide. He is also proposing an AI Neolab (a new lab built to do its own research). No profiled company has paid for coverage, and none is a customer, investor or affiliate of the publisher. The proposal is separate from the research, which follows the same rules for every company.

Status: a proposal. Learning gains and commercial demand remain unproven.

The proposed lab starts from one training idea that research can test. Its own research must show a measurable gain in training. Investors or AI labs interested in the proposed lab: contact the publisher.

Our sourced figures

57 adult alumni profiles researched
From 170 competition alumni screened (2011–2026). Only adults with source support count. This is recruiting research. These people are not a signed team, and the directory is not published.
Mercor’s annualized pace (recent revenue projected across a full year)
The latest is $2B for Jun 2026. Felicis reports the pace; Sacra estimates the gross basis. Gross is customer spend before contractor payouts, per Sacra’s estimate. Mercor has not disclosed its net revenue. This is not our revenue. See the Mercor profile.

Evidence checks · 28 October 2026

Selected financial documents and paid-work listings were rechecked. This is a partial refresh: older figures retain their reporting dates, and unavailable pages remain flagged. Financial checks · JSON · 256 kB · Work checks · JSON · 916.7 kB

01 / SOURCE

Who said it?

A filing, a company statement, and a news report carry different evidence. Open any figure to inspect its source.

02 / PERIOD

When did it happen?

The reporting period and the date we checked a page are separate. A recent check does not turn an old figure into current revenue.

03 / BASIS

Does it compare?

Annual revenue, annualized pace, and a division’s sales measure different things. Missing figures stay unknown.

What the labels mean

Confidence grades

Every claim gets a grade for how strongly its sources support it.

A
Independent or buyer-side evidence, such as a filing or a customer who confirms the work.
B
The company, an investor or another named first-hand source says it.
C
Reporting by others, an estimate, or indirect evidence.
U
Not confirmed. The fact may be undisclosed or still unresolved.

Tap or click a figure on a company page or in Compare to see its sources and grade.

Evidence labels. Each claim also names who stands behind it, such as Company-reported or Filed disclosure. A buyer’s confirmation and a company’s own statement get different labels.

How we assess evidence of delivery

Delivery evidence levels

Each company also gets a delivery evidence level (public proof that it sells and delivers its offer). The level covers one part of the business, such as the whole company or its AI data work.

About and corrections

ScienceToStartup is published by Musa Ozdem. It is a guide to the companies that produce AI training data, built from public sources. No profiled company has paid for coverage, and none is a customer, investor or affiliate of the publisher. The publisher has applied for paid work at some profiled companies and is a member of A.Team's talent network.

Disclosure. The publisher is also proposing an AI research lab, described on the overview page. That proposal is separate from this research, which applies the same rules to every company.

Lab inquiries. Investors or AI labs interested in the proposed lab can email musaeminozdem@gmail.com.

Request a correction

If a figure, date or listing is wrong, email us the company name and a link to a source that shows the right value.

musaeminozdem@gmail.com

We review requests within seven days.

Personal data and removal. Company profiles name founders and executives from public company sources only. Profiles do not show personal contact details. If you are named here and want a record corrected or removed, email the same address. Visits are counted by Cloudflare Web Analytics, which sets no cookies.
